1:1: This passage is read on the Sunday before Christmas, called the Sunday of the Holy Fathers.
2:1: This passage is read on December 25, the Feast of the Nativity of Our Lord Jesus Christ (Christmas).
2:13: This passage is read on December 26, the Synaxis of the Theotokos.
3:13: This passage is read on January 6, the Feast of the Baptism of Our Lord Jesus Christ (Theophany).
5:14: This passage is read on days commemorating holy hierarchs.
6:14: This passage is read on the Sunday before Great Lent, called Cheese Fare Sunday or Forgiveness Sunday.
